verdict.rationale: Oneleet's Fieldwork page says users can "Describe your control" and have AI agents collect and validate evidence for it. The framework-removal docs also mention controls holding "custom content." Together these give thin first-party signals of custom-control support, but nothing documents building custom frameworks or attaching user-defined tests. Missing for 10: documented custom framework creation, custom control creation workflow, user-defined automated tests, configurable evidence requirements alongside built-in controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, I can add custom frameworks and custom controls with my own tests and evidence requirements alongside the built-in ones

citations.quote: Describe your control. Fieldwork’s AI agents collect, validate, and package the evidence – across your enterprise systems, on your schedule.
Controls stay when another framework requires them or when they contain work such as evidence, review history, assignments, or custom content.
